exclusions.ASI03: Lab agents share the operator identity by design; there is no multi-tenant identity plane to abuse. The finding this exclusion defers is tracked for the first client engagement with real identity boundaries.
exclusions.ASI04: No third-party MCP servers or agent-built artefacts are in the lab scope; supply-chain testing is exercised via the mcp-scanner/AIG adapters against our own configs instead.
exclusions.ASI08: Two lab targets exist but share no resources or message path, so no cascade is possible; inter-agent cascade testing requires a client estate with real agent-to-agent wiring.
exclusions.ASI09: No human approval gates exist in the lab; confirmation-fatigue testing is deferred to client estates where the gate is real. Ethical gate: never tested against uninvolved humans.

note: The A7 self-test scope. Tested: ASI01, ASI02, ASI05, ASI06, ASI10. Excluded with reasons: ASI03, ASI04, ASI08, ASI09. This asymmetry is deliberate and honest — the writeup publishes it as-is (C-4).
